description: Look up the published MTR fare between two stations in Hong Kong, by station name or MTR station id. Returns the Octopus adult/student/JoyYou-sixty/child/elderly/PWD fares and the single-journey adult fare in HKD, with the open-data source URL. Deterministic: same input, same answer. Read-only. No key required.

from.description: Origin station name (e.g. "Central") or MTR station id (e.g. "1").

to.description: Destination station name (e.g. "Tsim Sha Tsui") or MTR station id (e.g. "3").

name: mtr_fare
